name: wg-easy
label: WireGuard Easy
description: The easiest way to run WireGuard VPN with a web UI. Set WG_HOST to your server's PUBLIC IP/hostname and reveal the generated PASSWORD in Env Vars. IMPORTANT: WireGuard needs kernel capabilities this template cannot set — after creating, edit the generated compose to add cap_add: [NET_ADMIN, SYS_MODULE] and the net.ipv4 sysctls, or tunnels won't establish. Single-node only.
